name: Budj Bim National Park

facts.claim: National park in Victoria's Western District about 270 km west of Melbourne, co-managed with Gunditj Mirring Traditional Owners
Visitor area has a crater lake, lava canals and lava caves, with four walking options
Park forms part of the Gunditjmara cultural landscape, an Aboriginal cultural landscape
Tae Rak Aquaculture Centre, 30 min away, runs guided cultural tours and has a kooyang (eel) display tank

access_note: Parks Victoria page flags the Lake Surprise viewing platform as structurally unsafe and closed
unresolved: Fee: page shows no entry fee; assumed free as Victorian national park (camping fees separate)

name: Lake Surprise

facts.claim: Crater lake in Budj Bim National Park, walkable from the campground
Lake Surprise Walk descends from the lookout to the lake's edge
Longer Lava Canal Circuit Walk passes lava blisters, Tunnel Cave, Natural Bridge and a dry crater with views over the lake

access_note: Lookout viewing platform near the top car park is closed as structurally unsafe

name: Lower Glenelg National Park

facts.claim: 27,300-hectare national park about 323 km west of Melbourne
Glenelg River has carved a limestone gorge through the park
Riverside camping, fishing, canoeing and the Glenelg River Canoe Trail
Much of the Great South West Walk runs through the park

unresolved: Fee: page shows no entry fee; assumed free

name: Princess Margaret Rose Caves

facts.claim: Show cave in Lower Glenelg National Park with cave coral, rimstone pools and saw-toothed shawls
Guided tour of about 40-45 minutes; tourist cave opened 1941
Cave extends about 150 m and is about 15 m deep

access_note: Reported closed until late 2026 (Visit Mount Gambier); reopening unconfirmed

name: Tower Hill Wildlife Reserve

facts.claim: 614-hectare reserve in a dormant volcano crater, about 15 km north-west of Warrnambool
Emus, kangaroos, koalas, swans and ducks live inside the crater
Self-guided walks include Tower Hill Peak Walk, Lava Tongue Walk and Wagon Bay Loop Walk
Short detour from the Great Ocean Road; has a visitor centre
